entries.name: s3j-decode-cast-swallowed-dead-accept#0
entries.description: ergots' S3j. The spent tree is dead(EQ(DeserializeRegister(R4, SAny), GV)), and R4 holds the bytes of OptionGet(BI). Decoding them builds OptionGet, whose constructor casts its input's type to SOption (transformers.scala:600-601), and BI is typed SAny: a ClassCastException inside the decode. Kiama's strategy catches a ClassCastException and returns None (Rewriter.scala:180-191), so the node stays where it is, and in the dead branch it is never evaluated: valid. The decode threw before its charge. The input spends a box of value 1000000000 into one output of the same value, with no proof. BI = ByIndex(Tuple(0, 0), 0), typed SAny (a tuple is a collection of SAny); F(x) = Filter(x, (i: Int) => true); GV = OptionGet(GetVar(1, SAny)); dead(c) = sigmaProp(If(false, c, true)), whose c is never evaluated.
